prerequisite_rule: Needs the Earth base game.
what_it_adds: A sixth player, a seed resource with a Germinate action to search the deck, 80 new cards and an extra board for storing sprouts.
what_it_fixes: Seeds help you find the cards you need for fauna goals, and the extra board lets you store sprouts you cannot place yet.
verdict_reason: BGG 8.06 from 838 ratings. A BGG review calls it a smooth fit that is easy to leave in; a poster says most of their players choose it for the seed abilities and sprout storage.
notes: 1-6 players: the sixth seat is Abundance-only. The extra board adds table footprint (BGG review). Publisher page lists a YouTube how-to-play video. Rating read 2026-10-15.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Earth base game; BGG posters recommend also owning Abundance.
what_it_adds: 36 animal cards with animeeples that roam your tableau and trigger when you use a leaf, plus a global animal ability each round.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.71 from 218 ratings. One review likes the extra scoring puzzle but says beginners struggle to trigger animals; a 26-reply thread calls some animal powers unbalanced.
notes: Rating read 2026-10-15. Whether Abundance is required is not stated by the publisher page; BGG posters say animals trigger on leaves and Abundance makes that easier (leaf to seed). Verdict rests on three BGG threads, one of them a single-reviewer complaint; early reception (backer deliveries June 2026).

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Wyrmspan base game.
what_it_adds: 80 new dragons, 25 caves, 14 objective tiles, 5 dragon guilds, trainable fledgling dragons and a new round tracker that offers an income choice when you pass.
what_it_fixes: The new round tracker lets you gain cards or eggs when you pass or end a round, so you run out of dragons or caves in hand less often (BGG review).
verdict_reason: BGG 8.36 from 811 ratings. Two BGG reviews like the round tracker and replayability; one found fledglings extra effort at first, and a 70-play poster finds hatchlings less useful.
notes: Publisher store lists USD 25.00 (compare-at 30.00). It is the only Wyrmspan expansion BGG lists. The publisher page also sells a bundle with Stone Eggs (not tracked). Counts of dragons, caves, objectives and guilds come from a BGG review, not the publisher page. Rating read 2026-10-15.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Ares Expedition base game.
what_it_adds: Awards and milestones, upgradeable phase cards, wild-tag project cards and new corporations and projects.
what_it_fixes: Adds end-game awards and in-game milestones, giving each game goals to chase.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.96 from 724 ratings. A BGG poster calls it the most highly recommended expansion for solo and two players, and another says it also works solo or co-op.
notes: BGG lists 1-4 players; a BGG reply confirms it works with six players when Foundations is added. Retailer street price USD 19.99 (Highlander Hobbies, 2026-10-15); no publisher MSRP found, so price left blank. A BGG poster shares house rules to reduce randomness in awards and milestone selection.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Ares Expedition base game.
what_it_adds: Player boards, cubes and phase cards for five or six players, a larger score track and a fourth infrastructure track with new project cards.
what_it_fixes: Lets groups of five or six play Ares Expedition.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.53 from 367 ratings. Only needed for five or six players; a BGG poster says 1-4 players never need it and that two-player tests were not recommended.
notes: Retailer street price USD 20.99 (Highlander Hobbies, 2026-10-15); no publisher MSRP found, so price left blank. The infrastructure track is optional with 2-4 players and makes the game longer, per a BGG reply; it is not designed for solo or Crisis mode per the same poster.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the Ares Expedition base game.
what_it_adds: Co-op mode: players face a new Crisis card each round that lowers terraforming metrics until its goal is met, and win by re-terraforming Mars.
what_it_fixes: Turns Ares Expedition into a cooperative game for groups that prefer playing together.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.87 from 773 ratings. Co-op fans call it one of the best-designed co-op expansions; critics say the crisis deck is small and repetitive, and it suits co-op groups only.
notes: Retailer street price USD 19.99 (Highlander Hobbies, 2026-10-15); no publisher MSRP found, so price left blank. Amazon title lists 2 to 4 players while BGG lists 1-4; BGG posters say solo play works. The criticism of a small, repetitive crisis deck is quoted by a BGG poster from video reviews.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game (it only has a small deck of its own).
what_it_adds: Two decks of new characters and cards, plus a second Renegade card, so the game runs with three to eight players.
what_it_fixes: Lets BANG! run with as few as three or as many as eight players.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.87 from 4,686 ratings, the most-rated BANG! expansion. The publisher page and BGG both list it as the way to reach 8 players, which the base game cannot do.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 17.90; no USD price verified, so price left blank. Dodge City is not playable without the base game, per a BGG reply. Amazon /dp page title matched Bang! Dodge City Card Game.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: Dangerous cards (weapons, gear and ammo) that take load tokens, upgrades for brown-bordered cards, and eight new characters.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.19 from 255 ratings. A BGG poster recommends it over Gold Rush because it adds many interesting cards to the main deck.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 17.90; no USD price verified. The 2024 BGG recommendation is a single reply to a question about which of two expansions to buy.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: Eight new characters, gold nuggets to buy equipment from a shop deck, and a Shadow Gunslinger variant for eliminated players.
what_it_fixes: Eliminated players can keep taking part through the Shadow Gunslinger variant.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.73 from 1,010 ratings. A BGG poster says its gold economy encourages aggression and can be swingy at eight players; a review calls it pricey for the components.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 17.90; no USD price verified. The review quoting a GBP 19.99 price is from 2022 and a UK shop.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: A moving train of Railroad cards and Station tiles, Railcars you can buy, a Locomotive effect and eight new characters.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.08 from 73 ratings. A BGG poster owns it alongside Dodge City; one asks if it is worth it and gets no reply, so the evidence is thin.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 17.90; no USD price verified. Thin evidence: only 73 BGG ratings, and BGG lists a 60 minute play time. Co-designed with Czech and Slovak players, per BGG.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: 16 legendary versions of classic characters, 16 Feat cards and 35 Fame tokens: complete feats or boast to gain fame and stronger abilities.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.48 from 44 ratings. Threads show players confused by when to boast or claim feats, and few reviews exist yet, so evidence is thin.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 17.90; no USD price verified. Thin evidence: 44 ratings; verdict draws on thread titles and the publisher description, not on written reviews.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: Eight wild new characters plus scenario cards that change the rules after a Wells Fargo is played, and odd action cards, in a double-faced mini box.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.71 from 1,030 ratings. A BGG poster says it has the best characters of any expansion but dislikes its scenario deck.
notes: Sold today only inside the BANG! Expansion Pack (with Wild West Show, The Valley of Shadows, High Noon and A Fistful of Cards), per the publisher page; standalone copies are secondhand. The recommendation rests on one BGG reply.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: Eight new characters plus rattlesnake, tornado and bandido cards based on Czech fan submissions, with design help from Emiliano Sciarra.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.34 from 503 ratings, the highest of the older expansions. Evidence is the rating and forum rules questions, not written reviews.
notes: Sold today only inside the BANG! Expansion Pack (with Wild West Show, The Valley of Shadows, High Noon and A Fistful of Cards), per the publisher page; standalone copies are secondhand. Thin evidence: verdict leans on the BGG rating and an active rules forum.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: 15 High Noon event cards: the Sheriff reveals one each turn that every player must obey, plus a Ghost Town turn where eliminated players return as ghosts.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.70 from 1,803 ratings. The publisher calls it cheap and easy to play; a BGG poster always uses the High Noon card but skips the event cards they dislike.
notes: Sold today only inside the BANG! Expansion Pack (with Wild West Show, The Valley of Shadows, High Noon and A Fistful of Cards), per the publisher page; standalone copies are secondhand. High Noon and A Fistful of Cards decks can be mixed per a BGG FAQ note.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: 15 new event cards co-designed with winners of a fan card contest; the deck can be shuffled with High Noon for variety.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.49 from 1,559 ratings, the lowest of the main expansions. It matters only if you want more event cards to mix with High Noon.
notes: Sold today only inside the BANG! Expansion Pack (with Wild West Show, The Valley of Shadows, High Noon and A Fistful of Cards), per the publisher page; standalone copies are secondhand. Thin evidence: verdict rests on the BGG rating and one forum post saying disliked event cards never get played.

prerequisite_rule: Needs the BANG! base game.
what_it_adds: Nine promo cards: Claus the Saint, Uncle Will, Johnny Kisch, Handcuffs, New Identity, Annie Versary, Emiliano and two blanks for a custom character and event.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.56 from only 8 ratings. A nine-card promo pack, also inside the Dynamite Box; worth it only for collectors or if you lack those promo cards.
notes: dV Giochi shop lists EUR 7.90; no USD price verified. Thin evidence: 8 BGG ratings and no forum threads read; verdict follows from the card list alone.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards: the Orc race, monsters like the Hydrant and Tentacle Demon, plus Unnatural Axe, Spiked Codpiece and other items.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.43 from 7,629 ratings, the most-rated Munchkin expansion. Cards just mix into the base deck, and the set is also inside the Big Box.
notes: One 2004 BGG poster found it weak (only the Orc race is new); a 2025 owner counted 108 cards in the 2013 printing versus 112 now. The Munchkin Big Box (June 2025, USD 134.95) includes it. A BGG thread (Oct 2025) reports a Munchkin second edition announced on BackerKit.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards: the Gnome race, the Bard class, new monsters and items such as the Chainmail Bikini, plus five cards by webcomic artists.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.46 from 5,530 ratings. Adds one race and one class to the base deck; buy it only if you want more variety than Munchkin 2 gives.
notes: Large, steady ratings but no strong praise or complaint found in threads. The Munchkin Big Box (June 2025, USD 134.95) includes it. A BGG thread (Oct 2025) reports a Munchkin second edition announced on BackerKit.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards that introduce Steeds (mounts) and many Hirelings you can sacrifice for their powers.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.54 from 3,925 ratings. Steeds and Hirelings add new things to play, but the rating is close to Munchkin 2 and 3.
notes: Cards carry a set icon from this expansion on, per a BGG reply, which makes the set easy to pull back out.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards: the Ranger class that tames monsters, new monsters and treasure, and European-publisher monsters in English for the first time.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.58 from 2,231 ratings. A new class plus imported monsters give it more fresh content than most numbered sets.
notes: Thin on written praise; the verdict rests on the card list and the BGG rating.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 40 double-size Dungeon cards that change the rules and 32 Portals, collecting Demented Dungeons and Terrible Tombs in one box.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.39 from 54 ratings (Terrible Tombs 7.26 from 160). One box replaces two older sets, and its Dungeon cards change the rules.
notes: Collects BGG items Demented Dungeons (6.43 from 2,063 ratings) and Terrible Tombs (7.26 from 160). Evidence for the combined box is thin. It is also inside the Big Box.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 powerful cards: Ultra-style race and class enhancers, more monster and item enhancers and low-level monsters, made for big mixed decks.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.58 from 884 ratings. Its overpowered cards are meant for groups that already mix several Munchkin sets, so skip it with only the base game.
notes: The publisher page says it was made to speed up games that combine many sets; it is a different BGG item from Munchkin 7: More Good Cards.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards: Centaur and Lizard races, Elite, Legendary and Elder enhancers, and new monsters like the Centaurpede.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.74 from 904 ratings, the best score among numbered sets 2 to 8 with at least 800 ratings. Two new races and three enhancers.
notes: Rating gaps among numbered sets are small, so this is a mild preference.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards of primeval armor, dinosaur Steeds and prehistoric monsters, compatible with any version of Munchkin.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.30 from 129 ratings, higher than the older numbered sets. A themed set with Steeds that works with any Munchkin version.
notes: Fewer ratings than sets 2 to 8, so the score is less settled.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards of history-themed monsters and gear, such as Cleopatra and her Pet Roc, the Philosopher's Stone and a Ming Vase.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.35 from only 26 ratings. Newest numbered set and in print; the rating is promising but too thin to rank higher.
notes: Thin evidence: 26 BGG ratings and no review threads found; verdict rests on the rating and the card list. Publisher calls it the most recent numbered expansion.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 15 cards for the Sparkly Good Fairy and Fairy Dust rewards for players who help each other.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.52 from 698 ratings. Out of print; the cards are inside Munchkin Game Changers, so buy that or skip it unless you find it cheap.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand. The publisher page lists April 2010 while BGG lists 2009.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 15 cards: the Munchkinomicon book and 14 nasty spells such as Eldritch Cleaver and Unnatural Compulsion.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.73 from 482 ratings. Out of print; its cards are inside Munchkin Game Changers, so skip the lone pack unless it is cheap.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand. BGG also has a duplicate item 312905 with 10 ratings.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 15 cards that make monsters tougher: 13 old favorites in full color plus Hollywood and Ultimate.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.63 from 288 ratings. Out of print; the cards are inside Munchkin Game Changers, so buy that box or skip this pack.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 15 cards: the Dark and High race modifiers, the Master class modifier, two Reloaded dice and a Something*Positive card, now in color.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.59 from 290 ratings. Out of print; these cards are inside Munchkin Game Changers, so skip the lone pack unless it is cheap.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 68 cards, two level counters and two dice that collect Fairy Dust, Munchkinomicon, Monster Enhancers, Reloaded and Fairy Dust Dice cards.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.60 from 236 ratings. The easiest way to get four out-of-print mini sets in one box, but the box itself is out of print.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand. BGG lists 2013 while the publisher page lists a May 2022 printing. Verdict rests on the card list and ratings, not on reviews.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 78 hard-to-find cards that were once sold in publisher store sets, plus the Knights and Marked for Death booster packs.
verdict_reason: BGG 6.64 from 54 ratings. Out of print; it only gathers rare cards from other Munchkin games, so it suits completists.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand. Publisher page lists September 2017 for this printing; BGG lists 2015. A few odd-sized cards are not included. Thin evidence: 54 ratings; the only BGG thread is titled Card list?.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 30 cards of secret goals you can complete for a reward, or even a surprise way to win.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.23 from 30 ratings. A cheap 30-card pack that adds secret goals; it is also inside the Big Box.
notes: Thin evidence: 30 ratings and no threads found. The Munchkin Big Box (June 2025, USD 134.95) includes it. A BGG thread (Oct 2025) reports a Munchkin second edition announced on BackerKit.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 30 more secret goals and rewards, harder but more tempting than the first set.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.12 from 8 ratings. Only useful if you already like Side Quests; the evidence is very thin.
notes: Thin evidence: 8 BGG ratings and no threads found. The Big Box includes it with new John Kovalic art. Developed by Devin Lewis; illustrated by Len Peralta.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 30 cards of boss monsters and buffs for a battle-royale ending to your game.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.54 from 14 ratings. Out of print, but also inside the Big Box; a good late-game add if you already play often.
notes: Out of print per the publisher page, so the SRP is the original price and copies are secondhand. Thin evidence: 14 ratings, and a 2022 BGG reply lists Bosses as an add-in that should not break the game.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 112 cards: a new Druid class with nature monsters and weapons, such as the Night Shade and the Death Cap.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.50 from 8 ratings. A full-size set built around one class, so buy it only if you want a Druid and more nature monsters.
notes: Thin evidence: 8 BGG ratings and no threads found. Developed by Devin Lewis.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 30 cards of witch monsters with matching Items and Curses, usable with any Munchkin set.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.88 from 8 ratings. A small themed pack that works with any Munchkin set; thin evidence, so treat it as a theme pick.
notes: Thin evidence: 8 BGG ratings and no threads found. Publisher says to shuffle it into Munchkin Pathfinder so players can be Witches too.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards that add more Undead monsters and gear to your deck, such as the Talismantle and Ectoplasma Rifle.
verdict_reason: BGG 8.25 from 4 ratings. A themed pack with no real evidence yet, so buy it only if you want more undead monsters.
notes: Thin evidence: 4 BGG ratings and no reviews found; verdict rests on the publisher card description. Munchkin Undead (a separate small pack) is not covered here.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards of golems and rock-themed monsters, plus Hard as a Rock, Hard Hat and Automatic Chisel.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.50 from 4 ratings. A themed 56-card pack with almost no ratings yet; buy it for the golem theme only.
notes: Thin evidence: 4 BGG ratings and no reviews found.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards of horse-themed monsters, curses and items plus a herd of new Steeds.
verdict_reason: BGG 7.50 from 4 ratings. A themed 56-card pack with almost no ratings yet; most useful if you like Steeds.
notes: Thin evidence: 4 BGG ratings and no reviews found.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards of bug monsters, items and the Bug race from Star Munchkin, made to mix into other Munchkin sets.
verdict_reason: BGG 8.20 from 5 ratings. A themed 56-card pack with very few ratings; its Bug race is the main new rule.
notes: Thin evidence: 5 BGG ratings and no reviews found.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards of cute-but-dangerous creatures such as Dust Bunnies and the Wolpertinger, with Bunchucks and a Fur Cloak.
verdict_reason: BGG 8.50 from 2 ratings. A themed 56-card pack with almost no evidence; treat it as a theme pick.
notes: Thin evidence: 2 BGG ratings and no reviews found. The publisher page has no Buy button; the Warehouse 23 shop lists it as available.

prerequisite_rule: Needs Munchkin or any other Munchkin set; it is not a standalone game.
what_it_adds: 56 cards of mischievous monkey cards, such as Monkey Suit, Go Bananas and You Blew It Up.
verdict_reason: BGG 8.00 from 4 ratings. The newest pack here, with almost no evidence; buy it only if you want the monkey theme.
notes: Thin evidence: 4 BGG ratings and no reviews found.
